definition_en: a diagram that shows how numbers or amounts relate
core_image: 一条折线在方格纸上爬升
scene: 老师把成绩画成了一张图表。The teacher drew the results as a graph.

senses.title: A diagram of numbers

senses.example: The teacher drew the results as a graph.
senses.exampleCN: 老师把成绩画成了一张图表。

definition_en: a low green plant that covers the ground
core_image: 晨露挂在草叶尖上
scene: 孩子们在草地上打滚。The children rolled on the grass.

senses.title: The green plant

senses.example: The field is covered with grass.

senses.title: Ground covered with grass
senses.definition: an area of ground covered with grass
senses.definitionCN: 长满草的一片地面

senses.exampleCN: 孩子们在草地上打滚。
senses.why: The plant name stands for the surface it makes.

intro.en: Grass is an old English word of Germanic origin.
intro.cn: grass 是源自古英语的日耳曼语词。

items.en: Græs named the low green plant.
items.cn: græs 指低矮的绿色植物。

items.en: The word also meant the ground it covered.
items.cn: 这个词也指它覆盖的地面。

items.en: Grass kept both the plant and field senses.
items.cn: grass 保留了植物与场地两义。

items.en: Grassy and grasshopper grew from it.
items.cn: grassy 与 grasshopper 由它派生。

items.en: Slang gave it the sense of an informer.
items.cn: 俚语又赋予它「告密者」之义。

note.en: Grass is compared with look-alike words and words for green ground.
note.cn: 把 grass 与形近词以及表示绿地的词作比较。

entries.definition: short cut grass around a house
a plant used for food or medicine

normalIntro.en: Grass is the green carpet the earth grows for itself.
normalIntro.cn: 草，是大地为自己长出的绿毯。

normal.en: The grass is wet with dew.
He cut the grass on Sunday.
We had a picnic on the grass.

abstract.en: Grass bends but rarely breaks.
abstract.cn: 草会弯，却很少断。

abstract.en: The greenest lawn is the one next door.
abstract.cn: 最绿的草坪，总在邻居家。

abstract.en: Small blades hold the soil in place.
abstract.cn: 小小的草叶，把泥土留住。

examples.en: The field is covered with grass.
examples.cn: 田野上长满了草。

examples.en: The children rolled on the grass.
examples.cn: 孩子们在草地上打滚。

examples.en: He was called a grass by the gang.

dict_mnemonic.text: grass 是「草」，也指「草地」；cut the grass 是割草，keep off the grass 是请勿践踏草坪；grassy 是形容词，grasshopper 是蚱蜢。

root: 来自古英语 græs，属日耳曼语族，核心义为低矮的绿色植物，后兼指草地，并在俚语中引申为告密者。

sensesIntro.en: Grass means the plant, ground covered with it, or, in slang, an informer.
sensesIntro.cn: grass 指草、草地，或在俚语中指告密者。

core.en: A green carpet grown from the ground.
core.cn: 从地里长出的绿色地毯。

branches.en: A single blade bends in the wind.
branches.cn: 一片草叶在风中弯下。

branches.en: A wide lawn shines after rain.
branches.cn: 雨后的草坪闪着光。

branches.en: A whisper passes along a back street.
branches.cn: 一句低语在小巷里传开。

branches.en: The plant and the field are one green.
branches.cn: 草与草地，是同一种绿。

branches.en: What is low and common can also hide.
branches.cn: 低矮常见之物，也能藏住东西。

intro.en: Grass forms plurals, adjectives, and compounds.
intro.cn: grass 构成复数、形容词和复合词。

latinIntro.en: Grass has no Latin root; it comes from Old English.
latinIntro.cn: grass 没有拉丁词根，它来自古英语。

definition_en: feeling thankful for something
core_image: 一个人双手接过礼物，眼里带着谢意
scene: 她感激朋友在她困难时的帮助。She was grateful to her friend for the help.
sceneCN: 这里 grateful 是「感激的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她感激朋友在她困难时的帮助。

senses.title: Feeling thankful
senses.definition: feeling thankful for something received
senses.definitionCN: 因得到帮助而心怀感谢的
senses.example: She was grateful to her friend for the help.
senses.exampleCN: 她感激朋友在她困难时的帮助。
senses.why: Thankful feeling is the core modern sense.
senses.whyCN: 心怀感谢是现代最核心的用法。

senses.title: Expressing thanks
senses.definition: showing or expressing thanks
senses.definitionCN: 表达谢意的
senses.example: He sent a grateful letter.
senses.exampleCN: 他寄了一封感谢信。
senses.why: The feeling is turned into words and gifts.
senses.whyCN: 把感激之情化为文字与礼物。

senses.title: Pleasing
senses.definition: pleasant or welcome, in older use
senses.definitionCN: 旧用法中指令人愉快、受欢迎的
senses.example: The grateful shade saved us from the sun.
senses.exampleCN: 宜人的树荫让我们免于日晒。
senses.why: The oldest sense is simply pleasing.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项就是「令人愉快的」。

intro.en: Grateful comes from Latin gratus, pleasing or thankful.
intro.cn: grateful 来自拉丁语 gratus，意为令人愉快的或感激的。

items.en: Gratus meant pleasing or thankful.
items.cn: gratus 意为令人愉快的或感激的。

items.en: Gratia meant grace, thanks, and favor.
items.cn: gratia 意为恩惠、感谢与好感。

items.en: Gratus grew the sense of feeling thanks.
items.cn: gratus 发展出心怀感谢之义。

items.en: Grateful entered English as thankful.
items.cn: grateful 以「感激的」之义进入英语。

items.en: It also kept the older sense of pleasing.
items.cn: 它也保留了较古老的「令人愉快」之义。

note.en: Grateful is compared with look-alike words and words for thanks.
note.cn: 把 grateful 与形近词以及表示感谢的词作比较。

normalIntro.en: Grateful is the heart saying thank you.
normalIntro.cn: grateful 就是心里在说谢谢。

normal.en: I am grateful for your help.
She felt grateful to the doctor.
We are grateful for the rain.
They were grateful to be safe.

abstract.en: Gratitude turns what we have into enough.
abstract.cn: 感激，让已有的变成足够。

abstract.en: A grateful heart keeps a light on.
abstract.cn: 感激的心，总留着一盏灯。

abstract.en: Small kindnesses are remembered longest.
abstract.cn: 微小的善意，记得最久。

examples.en: She was grateful to her friend for the help.
examples.cn: 她感激朋友在她困难时的帮助。

examples.en: He sent a grateful letter.
examples.cn: 他寄了一封感谢信。

examples.en: The grateful shade saved us from the sun.
examples.cn: 宜人的树荫让我们免于日晒。

root: 来自拉丁语 gratus（令人愉快的、感激的），经中古英语进入英语，核心义由「讨人喜欢的」转为「心怀感谢的」。

core.en: A heart warmed by a received kindness.

branches.en: A hand rests on the heart.
branches.cn: 一只手按在胸口。

branches.en: A short letter says more than it must.
branches.cn: 一封短信，说的比该说的多。

branches.en: Cool shade welcomes a tired walker.
branches.cn: 凉爽的树荫迎接疲惫的行人。

branches.en: Feeling and words belong together.
branches.cn: 心情与言语，本该成对。

branches.en: Thanks can be spoken or simply felt as comfort.
branches.cn: 谢意可以说出口，也可以化作舒适。

intro.en: Grateful forms comparison, adverbs, and nouns.

latinIntro.en: The Latin root is gratus, pleasing or thankful.

definition_en: very large, important, or excellent
core_image: 一座高大的拱门在晨光中屹立
scene: 这是一位伟大的科学家。This is a great scientist.
sceneCN: 这里 great 是「伟大的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：这是一位伟大的科学家。

senses.title: Outstanding in worth
senses.definition: outstanding in ability, worth, or fame
senses.definitionCN: 在才能、价值或名声上出众的
senses.example: This is a great scientist.
senses.exampleCN: 这是一位伟大的科学家。
senses.why: Greatness of person is a central modern sense.
senses.whyCN: 人的伟大是现代核心义之一。

senses.title: Large in amount
senses.definition: very large in size, amount, or importance
senses.definitionCN: 在规模、数量或重要性上很大的
senses.example: The storm caused great damage.
senses.exampleCN: 暴风雨造成了巨大破坏。
senses.why: The old sense of size grew into importance.

senses.title: Very good

items.en: Great meant thick or coarse.

items.en: It extended to importance and fame.

items.en: Spoken English made it mean excellent.

note.en: Great is compared with look-alike words and words for size and excellence.

normalIntro.en: Great is a word that grew from thick to grand.

examples.en: This is a great scientist.

intro.en: Ground comes from Old English grund, the bottom of something, from a Germanic root.
intro.cn: ground 来自古英语 grund（底部），源于日耳曼语词根。

items.en: The root meant the bottom or floor.
items.cn: 该词根意为底部或地面。

items.en: Grund meant the bottom of land or water.
items.cn: grund 指陆地或水底的底部。

items.en: Ground named the surface of the earth.
items.cn: ground 指地球表面。

items.en: The sense widened to areas for sport.
items.cn: 词义扩展到运动场地。

items.en: The reason sense grew from foundation.
items.cn: 「理由」义由「基础」引申而来。

note.en: Ground is compared with look-alike words and words for land or reasons.
note.cn: 把 ground 与形近词以及表示土地或理由的词作比较。

entries.definition: the solid part of the earth

normalIntro.en: Ground is the earth underfoot, a field for play, and the basis for an argument.
normalIntro.cn: ground 是脚下的土地、活动的场地，也是论证的依据。

normal.en: They play on the school ground.
He was refused on medical grounds.
The plane is still on the ground.
Our room is on the ground floor.

abstract.en: Every argument needs solid ground.
abstract.cn: 每个论证都需要坚实的地基。

abstract.en: What lies underfoot holds up the field.
abstract.cn: 脚下的土地，托起整片场地。

abstract.en: A reason is a floor for belief.
abstract.cn: 理由，是信念的地板。

examples.en: The children sat on the ground.
examples.cn: 孩子们坐在地上。

examples.en: The school has a new sports ground.
examples.cn: 学校有一个新的运动场。

examples.en: They refused on the grounds of cost.
examples.cn: 他们以成本为理由拒绝了。

dict_mnemonic.text: ground 是「地面、场地、理由」；on the ground 是在地上，ground floor 是一楼，on the grounds of 是以……为理由；ground 也是 grind 的过去式。

root: 来自古英语 grund（底部），源于日耳曼语词根；由「地面、地基」引申为活动场地，再引申为论证的「根据、理由」。

sensesIntro.en: Ground means the earth's surface, an area for activity, or a basis for belief.
sensesIntro.cn: ground 指地面、活动场地，或信念的依据。

core.en: The solid base under everything.
core.cn: 万物之下坚实的基底。

branches.en: Feet press into soft soil.
branches.cn: 双脚踩进松软的泥土。

branches.en: White lines mark a playing field.
branches.cn: 白线画出比赛场地。

branches.en: A lawyer states a clear basis.
branches.cn: 律师陈述明确的依据。

branches.en: A field is ground given a purpose.
branches.cn: 场地，就是被赋予用途的土地。

branches.en: Foundation and reason both hold things up.
branches.cn: 地基与理由，都在托住事物。

intro.en: Ground forms plurals, verb parts, and many place words.
intro.cn: ground 构成复数、动词变化以及许多地点词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，属于日耳曼语来源。

items.example: The grounds are open to all.

items.meaning: kept on the ground or based

items.example: She has a good grounding in maths.

items.meaning: a place for children to play

definition_en: a number of people or things together, or to put them together
core_image: 一群学生围成半圆站在门口
scene: 一群学生站在门口。A group of students stood at the door.
sceneCN: 这里 group 是「群、组」（第 1 个义项）；句意：一群学生站在门口。

senses.title: Set of people or things
senses.definition: several people or things that are together
senses.definitionCN: 聚在一起的一些人或物
senses.example: A group of students stood at the door.
senses.exampleCN: 一群学生站在门口。
senses.why: This is the basic collective sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最基本的集合义项。

senses.title: Organization
senses.definition: an organized set of people with a shared aim
senses.definitionCN: 有共同目标、组织起来的一群人
senses.example: She joined a research group.
senses.exampleCN: 她加入了一个研究团体。
senses.why: A crowd with a purpose becomes an organization.
senses.whyCN: 有目的的人群就成了组织。

senses.title: Put together
senses.definition: to put people or things into sets
senses.definitionCN: 把人或物分成若干组
senses.example: The teacher grouped the desks in fours.
senses.exampleCN: 老师把课桌每四张分成一组。
senses.why: The verb names the act of forming a group.
senses.whyCN: 动词义就是「组成一组」的动作。

intro.en: Group comes from French groupe, a cluster, from Italian gruppo, a knot.
intro.cn: group 来自法语 groupe（一簇），源头是意大利语 gruppo（结、团）。

items.en: The root meant a knot or a lump.
items.cn: 该词根意为结或团块。

items.en: Gruppo meant a knot or a cluster.
items.cn: gruppo 意为结或一簇。

items.en: Groupe meant a cluster of people or things.
items.cn: groupe 指人或物的一簇。

items.en: Group named a set of people or things.
items.cn: group 指一群人或一组物。

items.en: The verb sense of arranging grew later.
items.cn: 「分组」的动词义后来出现。

note.en: Group is compared with look-alike words and words for sets of people.
note.cn: 把 group 与形近词以及表示人群的词作比较。

entries.definition: a group working or playing together
a large number of people together

normalIntro.en: Group is a knot of people or things, and also the act of tying them together.
normalIntro.cn: group 是一群人或物结成的「团」，也是把他们归到一起的动作。

normal.cn: 她加入了一个学习小组。

normal.en: The age group was under ten.

abstract.en: A knot holds many threads as one.
abstract.cn: 一个结，把许多线合成一股。

abstract.en: Shared aims tie strangers together.
abstract.cn: 共同的目标，把陌生人系在一起。

abstract.en: To group is to decide what belongs.
abstract.cn: 分组，就是在决定什么属于一起。

examples.en: A group of students stood at the door.
examples.cn: 一群学生站在门口。

examples.en: She joined a research group.
examples.cn: 她加入了一个研究团体。

examples.en: The teacher grouped the desks in fours.
examples.cn: 老师把课桌每四张分成一组。

dict_mnemonic.text: group 是「组、群、团体」，也可作动词「分组」；a group of 是一群，age group 是年龄组，group together 是归为一组。

root: 来自法语 groupe（一簇），源头是意大利语 gruppo（结、团），更早与日耳曼语「结块」有关；由「结成一团」引申为人群、团体与分组。

sensesIntro.en: Group means a set of people or things, an organization, or to arrange things in sets.
sensesIntro.cn: group 指一群人或物、团体，或把事物分组。

core.en: Several things held together as one.
core.cn: 若干事物聚合成一个整体。

branches.en: Students gather in a loose circle.
branches.cn: 学生松散地围成一圈。

branches.en: Members sign a shared plan.
branches.cn: 成员签署一份共同的计划。

branches.en: Hands sort papers into piles.
branches.cn: 双手把纸张分成几叠。

branches.en: A crowd becomes a body with a name.
branches.cn: 人群变成有名有姓的团体。

branches.en: Gathering and sorting are two sides of one act.
branches.cn: 聚拢与归类，是同一动作的两面。

intro.en: Group forms plurals, verb parts, and compounds.
intro.cn: group 构成复数、动词变化和复合词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word came through French and Italian.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，经法语和意大利语传入。

items.example: The chairs were grouped by colour.

items.exampleCN: 这个分组看起来不均匀。

items.meaning: a smaller group inside a group
items.exampleCN: 每个小组选出一位负责人。

definition_en: to become larger, to plant and raise crops, or to change into a state
core_image: 番茄苗在阳光下一点点长高
scene: 番茄在阳光下生长。The tomatoes grow in the sun.
sceneCN: 这里 grow 是「生长」（第 1 个义项）；句意：番茄在阳光下生长。

senses.title: Become larger
senses.definition: to become larger or taller over time
senses.definitionCN: 随时间变大或长高
senses.example: The tomatoes grow in the sun.
senses.exampleCN: 番茄在阳光下生长。
senses.why: This is the basic biological sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最基本的生物义项。

senses.title: Raise plants
senses.definition: to plant and care for crops or plants
senses.definitionCN: 栽种并照料庄稼或植物
senses.example: They grow rice in the valley.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在山谷里种水稻。
senses.why: People make plants grow on purpose.
senses.whyCN: 人有意让植物生长，就是种植。

senses.title: Become a state
senses.definition: to change gradually into a state or condition
senses.definitionCN: 逐渐进入某种状态
senses.example: The sky grew dark.
senses.exampleCN: 天色变暗了。
senses.why: Growth became change of any kind.
senses.whyCN: 「生长」扩展为任何逐渐的变化。

intro.en: Grow comes from Old English growan, to grow, from a Germanic root.
intro.cn: grow 来自古英语 growan（生长），源于日耳曼语词根。

items.en: The root meant to grow or increase.
items.cn: 该词根意为生长、增加。

items.en: Growan meant to grow like a plant.
items.cn: growan 指像植物一样生长。

items.en: Grow kept the plant sense and gained increase.
items.cn: grow 保留植物义，并获得「增加」义。

items.en: The sense of becoming a state appeared.
items.cn: 「逐渐变成某种状态」的用法出现。

items.en: Growing crops became a common use.
items.cn: 「种植庄稼」成为常见用法。

note.en: Grow is compared with look-alike words and words for increase.
note.cn: 把 grow 与形近词以及表示增长的词作比较。

entries.definition: a set of people or things
to change into a fuller form

normalIntro.en: Grow is to get bigger, to make plants bigger, or to become something new.
normalIntro.cn: grow 是变大、把植物种大，或渐渐变成另一种状态。

normal.en: She grew up in a small town.

normal.cn: 这座城市每年都在扩张。

abstract.en: What is planted slowly becomes a tree.
abstract.cn: 种下的东西，会慢慢长成树。

abstract.en: Time makes both children and ideas grow.
abstract.cn: 时间让孩子与想法一同成长。

abstract.en: To grow is to accept becoming other.
abstract.cn: 成长，就是接受自己变成另一种样子。

examples.en: The tomatoes grow in the sun.
examples.cn: 番茄在阳光下生长。

examples.en: They grow rice in the valley.
examples.cn: 他们在山谷里种水稻。

examples.en: The sky grew dark.
examples.cn: 天色变暗了。

dict_mnemonic.text: grow 是「生长、种植、变得」；grow up 是长大，grow into 是长成，grow crops 是种庄稼；过去式 grew，过去分词 grown。

root: 来自古英语 growan（生长），源于日耳曼语词根；由植物生长扩展到数量增加、种植，以及逐渐变成某种状态。

sensesIntro.en: Grow means to become larger, to raise plants, or to change gradually into a state.
sensesIntro.cn: grow 指变大、种植植物，或逐渐变成某种状态。

core.en: Living things adding size over time.
core.cn: 活物随时间不断增加体积。

branches.en: A shoot lifts toward the light.
branches.cn: 嫩芽朝着光长高。

branches.en: Hands press seeds into soil.
branches.cn: 双手把种子按进土里。

branches.en: The evening sky turns grey.
branches.cn: 傍晚的天空转灰。

branches.en: Nature grows and people help it grow.
branches.cn: 自然让植物生长，人帮它生长。

branches.en: Size and state both change with time.
branches.cn: 体积与状态，都随时间改变。

intro.en: Grow forms irregular verb parts and several nouns.
intro.cn: grow 构成不规则动词变化和若干名词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，属于日耳曼语来源。

items.exampleCN: 本地种植者在这里出售。

definition_en: the process of becoming larger, an increase, or an abnormal lump in the body
core_image: 小树苗一年年长高成树
scene: 小树苗的生长需要阳光。The growth of the young tree needs sunlight.
sceneCN: 这里 growth 是「生长」（第 1 个义项）；句意：小树苗的生长需要阳光。

senses.title: Biological growth
senses.definition: the process by which a living thing becomes larger
senses.definitionCN: 生物变大的过程
senses.example: The growth of the young tree needs sunlight.
senses.exampleCN: 小树苗的生长需要阳光。
senses.why: This is the basic living sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是最基本的生命义项。

senses.title: Increase
senses.definition: an increase in size, number, or amount
senses.definitionCN: 规模、数量或金额的增加
senses.example: Economic growth slowed last year.
senses.exampleCN: 去年经济增长放缓。
senses.why: The living sense spread to numbers and trade.
senses.whyCN: 生命义扩展到数字与贸易。

senses.title: Abnormal lump
senses.definition: an unusual lump growing in or on the body
senses.definitionCN: 身体内外异常长出的肿块
senses.example: The doctor removed a small growth.
senses.exampleCN: 医生切除了一个小肿块。
senses.why: A growth is simply something that grows.
senses.whyCN: growth 字面上就是「长出来的东西」。

intro.en: Growth is grow plus the Old English noun ending -th, as in warmth and length.
intro.cn: growth 由 grow 加古英语名词后缀 -th 构成，类似 warmth 与 length。

items.en: The root meant to grow or increase.
items.cn: 该词根意为生长、增加。

items.en: Growan meant to grow.
items.cn: growan 意为生长。

items.en: The ending -th formed nouns of state.
items.cn: 后缀 -th 构成表示状态的名词。

items.en: Growthe named the process of growing.
items.cn: growthe 指生长的过程。

items.en: The sense widened to economic increase.
items.cn: 词义扩展到经济增长。

note.en: Growth is compared with look-alike words and words for increase.
note.cn: 把 growth 与形近词以及表示增长的词作比较。

entries.definition: a set of people or things

normalIntro.en: Growth is the noun of grow: a tree's rising, an economy's increase, or a lump.
normalIntro.cn: growth 是 grow 的名词：树的生长、经济的增长，或一个肿块。

normal.en: Plant growth is slow in winter.
Population growth puts pressure on cities.
normal.cn: 人口增长给城市带来压力。

normal.en: The scan showed a small growth.
normal.cn: 扫描显示有一个小肿块。

abstract.en: Every increase leaves a record of time.
abstract.cn: 每一次增长，都留下时间的记录。

abstract.en: What grows unseen still changes the shape.
abstract.cn: 看不见的生长，也在改变形状。

abstract.en: Growth asks for room before it asks for thanks.
abstract.cn: 成长先要空间，再谈感谢。

examples.en: The growth of the young tree needs sunlight.
examples.cn: 小树苗的生长需要阳光。

examples.en: Economic growth slowed last year.
examples.cn: 去年经济增长放缓。

examples.en: The doctor removed a small growth.
examples.cn: 医生切除了一个小肿块。

dict_mnemonic.text: growth 是 grow 的名词形式，指「生长、增长、发展」，医学上也指「赘生物」；economic growth 是经济增长，growth rate 是增长率。

root: 由 grow 加古英语名词后缀 -th 构成，表示「生长的过程或状态」；由生物生长扩展到数量、经济的增长，也指身体上的赘生物。

sensesIntro.en: Growth means biological growing, an increase in amount, or an abnormal lump.
sensesIntro.cn: growth 指生物生长、数量增长，或异常肿块。

core.en: The process of getting larger.
core.cn: 逐渐变大的过程。

branches.en: A young tree widens its trunk.
branches.cn: 小树加粗了自己的树干。

branches.en: A graph line climbs each quarter.
branches.cn: 曲线图每一季都在上升。

branches.en: A small lump appears under the skin.
branches.cn: 皮下出现一个小肿块。

branches.en: Living things and markets both rise.
branches.cn: 生物与市场，都在「长」。

branches.en: Increase is not always healthy.
branches.cn: 增长并不总是健康的。

intro.en: Growth forms plurals and links back to the verb grow.
intro.cn: growth 构成复数，并与动词 grow 相连。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，属于日耳曼语来源。

items.exampleCN: 过度生长的植物遮住了小路。

definition_en: a firm promise that something will be done, or a promise to repair or replace goods
core_image: 店家在收据上写下一年保修的承诺
scene: 店家保证一年内免费维修。The shop guarantees free repairs for a year.
sceneCN: 这里 guarantee 是「保证」（第 1 个义项）；句意：店家保证一年内免费维修。

senses.title: Firm promise
senses.definition: a formal promise that something will happen
senses.definitionCN: 对某事必定发生的正式承诺
senses.example: The shop guarantees free repairs for a year.
senses.exampleCN: 店家保证一年内免费维修。
senses.why: This is the general modern sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是现代最通用的义项。

senses.title: Product warranty
senses.definition: a written promise to repair or replace a product
senses.definitionCN: 对产品修理或更换的书面承诺
senses.example: The phone is still under guarantee.
senses.exampleCN: 这部手机还在保修期内。
senses.why: Shops turned the promise into a document.
senses.whyCN: 商家把承诺变成了一纸凭证。

senses.title: Legal surety
senses.definition: a promise to pay another person's debt if they fail
senses.definitionCN: 在他人无法偿还时替其付款的承诺
senses.example: His uncle guaranteed the loan.
senses.exampleCN: 他的叔叔为这笔贷款作了担保。
senses.why: The oldest sense is a pledge for another.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项是为他人作保。

intro.en: Guarantee comes from Old French garantie, a pledge of protection, from garantir, to protect.
intro.cn: guarantee 来自古法语 garantie（保护性担保），源头是 garantir（保护）。

items.en: The root meant to protect or guard.
items.cn: 该词根意为保护、看守。

items.en: Garant meant a person who protects.
items.cn: garant 指提供保护的人。

items.en: Garantie meant a pledge.
items.cn: garantie 意为担保、保证。

items.en: Guarantee meant a promise of safety.
items.cn: guarantee 意为安全的承诺。

items.en: The word also named a product warranty.
items.cn: 这个词也指产品保修。

note.en: Guarantee is compared with look-alike words and words for promises.
note.cn: 把 guarantee 与形近词以及表示承诺的词作比较。

entries.definition: a person who protects a place
a statement that you will do something

normalIntro.en: Guarantee began as protection and now means a firm promise or a warranty.
normalIntro.cn: guarantee 原指保护，如今指坚定的承诺或保修凭证。

normal.en: The watch has a two-year guarantee.
Hard work does not guarantee success.
Is the laptop still under guarantee?
normal.cn: 这台笔记本电脑还在保修期内吗？
他父亲为这笔贷款作了担保。

abstract.en: A promise is a wall built in advance.
abstract.cn: 承诺，是提前筑起的一道墙。

abstract.en: A warranty is trust written down.
abstract.cn: 保修，是把信任写成了文字。

abstract.en: No one can guarantee the weather.
abstract.cn: 没有人能保证天气。

examples.en: The shop guarantees free repairs for a year.
examples.cn: 店家保证一年内免费维修。

examples.en: The phone is still under guarantee.
examples.cn: 这部手机还在保修期内。

examples.en: His uncle guaranteed the loan.
examples.cn: 他的叔叔为这笔贷款作了担保。

dict_mnemonic.text: guarantee 是「保证、保修、担保」；under guarantee 是在保修期内，money-back guarantee 是退款保证；动词过去式加 d 变 guaranteed。

root: 来自古法语 garantie（担保），源头是 garantir（保护），更早与日耳曼语「看守、保护」有关；由「为人作保」扩展为一般承诺与产品保修。

sensesIntro.en: Guarantee means a firm promise, a product warranty, or legal surety for another.
sensesIntro.cn: guarantee 指坚定的承诺、产品保修，或为他人作法律担保。

core.en: A promise that stands behind something.
core.cn: 为某事撑腰的承诺。

branches.en: A seller gives a firm word.
branches.cn: 卖家给出坚定的承诺。

branches.en: A dated card sits in the box.
branches.cn: 盒子里放着一张注明日期的保修卡。

branches.en: A relative signs for a loan.
branches.cn: 一位亲属为贷款签字作保。

branches.en: The spoken promise becomes a paper right.
branches.cn: 口头的承诺变成纸上的权利。

branches.en: Goods and debts both need a backer.
branches.cn: 商品与债务，都需要有人兜底。

intro.en: Guarantee forms verb parts, an adjective, and legal nouns.

definition_en: a person who protects a place, the act of protecting, or a device that prevents harm

definition_en: to say something without being sure, or to think something is likely

scene: 我猜他要迟到。I guess he will be late.

senses.title: An attempt to guess

definition_en: a person invited to stay or visit, or a special visitor at an event

examples.en: He guided the team through the forest.
examples.cn: 他带领队伍穿过森林。

dict_mnemonic.text: guide 是「向导、指南、引导」；tour guide 是导游，guide book 是旅行指南，guide dog 是导盲犬；名词 guidance 是指导。

root: 来自古法语 guider（引导），可能源于日耳曼语「识路」的词根；由带路的人扩展为指南书和引导动作。

sensesIntro.en: Guide means a person who leads, an information book, or to lead the way.
sensesIntro.cn: guide 指向导、指南书，或引导带路。

core.en: Someone or something that knows the way.
core.cn: 认得路的某个人或某样东西。

branches.en: A flag lifts above a small tour group.
branches.cn: 小旗在旅行团上方举起。

branches.en: A folded book marks the main streets.
branches.cn: 一本折起的书标出主要街道。

branches.en: A hand points toward the station.
branches.cn: 一只手指向车站。

branches.en: Person and book both answer where.
branches.cn: 人与书，都在回答「往哪走」。

branches.en: Reading and walking both follow a line.
branches.cn: 阅读与行走，都沿着一条线。

intro.en: Guide forms verb parts and a family of direction words.
intro.cn: guide 构成动词变化以及一组表示方向的词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word came through Old French.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，经古法语传入。

items.exampleCN: 他们参加了有向导的徒步。

items.example: A guidepost stood at the bend.

definition_zh: 有罪的；内疚的；有过失的
definition_en: having committed a crime, feeling shame for a wrong, or responsible for a fault
core_image: 被告低头听陪审团宣读裁决
scene: 陪审团裁定他有罪。The jury found him guilty.
sceneCN: 这里 guilty 是「有罪的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：陪审团裁定他有罪。

senses.title: Legally responsible
senses.definition: having been proved to have committed a crime
senses.definitionCN: 被证明犯了罪的
senses.example: The jury found him guilty.
senses.exampleCN: 陪审团裁定他有罪。
senses.why: This is the legal sense that leads the word.
senses.whyCN: 这是这个词最主要的法律义项。

senses.title: Feeling shame
senses.definition: feeling bad because you have done something wrong
senses.definitionCN: 因做错事而心里难受
senses.example: She felt guilty about the lie.
senses.exampleCN: 她为那个谎言感到内疚。
senses.why: The court sense moved inward to feeling.
senses.whyCN: 法庭上的「有罪」转向内心的感受。

senses.title: Responsible for a fault
senses.definition: having caused a mistake or bad result
senses.definitionCN: 造成错误或不良后果的
senses.example: He was guilty of carelessness.
senses.exampleCN: 他犯了粗心的过失。
senses.why: Not every fault is a crime, yet blame remains.
senses.whyCN: 并非每个过失都是犯罪，但仍需担责。

intro.en: Guilty is guilt plus -y; guilt comes from Old English gylt, a crime or fault.
intro.cn: guilty 由 guilt 加 -y 构成；guilt 来自古英语 gylt，意为罪过。

items.en: The root meant a debt or a fault.
items.cn: 该词根意为欠债或过失。

items.en: Gylt meant a crime or sin.
items.cn: gylt 意为罪行或罪过。

items.en: Guilt named the state of having done wrong.
items.cn: guilt 指做错事的状态。

items.en: Guilty described a person in law.
items.cn: guilty 指法律上有罪的人。

items.en: The feeling sense grew strong in daily use.
items.cn: 日常使用中「内疚」义逐渐增强。

note.en: Guilty is compared with look-alike words and words for blame.
note.cn: 把 guilty 与形近词以及表示罪责的词作比较。

entries.definition: the fact of having done wrong
a large area of sea partly enclosed

normalIntro.en: Guilty starts in court and ends in the heart: a verdict, a fault, or a bad feeling.
normalIntro.cn: guilty 从法庭走进内心：裁决、过失，或难受的感觉。

abstract.en: A verdict names a fact; guilt names a weight.
abstract.cn: 裁决说出事实，内疚说出重量。

abstract.en: No court is needed for a quiet conscience.
abstract.cn: 良心的审判，不需要法庭。

abstract.en: Blame can be shared, but guilt is felt alone.
abstract.cn: 责任可以分担，内疚只能独自承受。

examples.en: The jury found him guilty.
examples.cn: 陪审团裁定他有罪。

examples.en: She felt guilty about the lie.
examples.cn: 她为那个谎言感到内疚。

examples.en: He was guilty of carelessness.
examples.cn: 他犯了粗心的过失。

dict_mnemonic.text: guilty 是「有罪的、内疚的」；feel guilty 是感到内疚，guilty of 是犯有……罪，not guilty 是无罪；名词是 guilt，副词是 guiltily。

root: 由 guilt 加形容词后缀 -y 构成，guilt 来自古英语 gylt（罪过）；由法律上的「有罪」扩展为内心的「内疚」和一般「有过失」。

sensesIntro.en: Guilty means legally responsible, feeling shame, or responsible for a fault.
sensesIntro.cn: guilty 指法律上有罪、心里内疚，或对过失负有责任。

core.en: Having done wrong, in law or in the heart.
core.cn: 在法律上或心里做错了事。

branches.en: A judge reads a solemn verdict.
branches.cn: 法官宣读庄严的裁决。

branches.en: A person looks away after a lie.
branches.cn: 说谎的人把目光移开。

branches.en: A report names a careless mistake.
branches.cn: 报告指出一处粗心的过失。

branches.en: The courtroom verdict echoes inside.
branches.cn: 法庭的裁决，会在内心回响。

branches.en: Small faults can leave a large weight.
branches.cn: 小的过失，也能留下沉重的负担。

intro.en: Guilty forms comparisons and a family of guilt words.
intro.cn: guilty 构成比较级以及一组与罪责相关的词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin root; the word is Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁词根，属于日耳曼语来源。

items.example: He was the guiltiest of them all.
items.exampleCN: 他是所有人中罪责最重的。

items.meaning: the state of having done wrong

items.example: He looked guiltily at the door.

items.exampleCN: 多年来他一直满怀内疚。
